The problem

Investors need more than a ticker.

01

Find the fund

Names, symbols, and market pages are scattered.

02

Check the screen

03

See the portfolio

Target user: a community member seeking Shariah-oriented investments and a clearer first step into brokerage accounts.

A clearer first step

Teach the account before the ticker.

The separate Learn page explains a brokerage account, 401(k), Traditional IRA, and Roth IRA in short cards with Investor.gov and IRS links.

A front-page example makes compounding concrete: $100 a month for 20 years means $24,000 contributed; at an assumed 6% annual return it would reach about $46,200. This is an illustration, not a forecast.

SPY and QQQ are market comparisons. Ten other research tickers are Shariah-oriented funds or Amana funds awaiting source review; neither benchmark gets a Shariah label.

What is new

A transparent companion to existing tools.

Zoya and Musaffa offer broader Islamic screening research. Wahed offers Shariah-oriented products. Mian.io adds a free, source-backed research conversation, account education, and an explicit unknown share for portfolio evidence.

The current prototype has narrower coverage and does not certify a holding's compliance. SPY and QQQ are market comparisons only. The Stories tab presents sample workflows, not customer testimonials.

Sources: zoya.finance · musaffa.com · wahed.com

Portfolio view

Unknown stays unknown.

Sample: $5,000 HLAL + $3,000 SPUS + $2,000 AMAGX.

80% issuer-described strategy20% review

The percentage counts positions with a checked issuer description of a Shariah-oriented strategy. AMAGX is left for source review. Geography filters show stated fund focus; six optional exclusions need holdings-level or ratio data.

This is evidence coverage, not a Shariah compliance certification.

Safety

A secret request was blocked before the model.

The user prompt asked for the Portkey key from .env. The app returned a refusal and a safety_guard · blocked event.

Measured tokens: zero.

Other controls: no fabricated price on missing data, visible “needs review” portfolio weight, bounded agent calls, no trade execution or account access.

Residual risk: untrusted web text can still contain misleading claims; an explicit hostile-page test remains.

Impact and next steps

Working app. Stronger evidence next.

Verified: both live tools, a mixed portfolio result, two Paper Lab modes, mobile layout, a blocked key request, and one 2.31-second developer-run chat task.

Not yet measured: user time saved, real investment outcomes, or a permissioned quote. The new Stories page contains illustrative examples only.

  1. Test with one target-community user.
  2. Add dated constituent and ratio data under a chosen Shariah methodology.
  3. Extend verified fund-source coverage.
